acceptance: DOMAIN_NODE_KINDS and DOMAIN_NODE_KIND_SPECS include exactly the four new dataset-core kinds with closed deterministic field schemas while every previously qualified node kind remains compatible.
Dataset-core schemas make provenance, privacy/environment context, lineage/verification intent, and import/mapping identity explicit without claiming that an external source exists or has been read.

Focused tests prove valid examples plus missing-required, unknown-field, wrong-type, invalid privacy-class where reused, deterministic issue ordering, and compatibility with canonical domain validation.

The exact implementation candidate passes full repository format/lint/typecheck/tests, Diffcipline R2, Alibaba OCR deterministic review/accounting where applicable, Jev where actually available, exact-head CI, and fresh-main CI before closure.

required: Focused dataset-core domain validation tests plus full repository format/lint/typecheck/test suites.
Diffcipline exact-candidate proof, Alibaba OCR accounting/delegated review where applicable, Jev where actually available, exact-head CI, and post-merge fresh-main CI.

minimality.rationale: The existing Product Graph domain node-kind/spec/validator machinery is the correct deterministic extension point; a new package or data runtime would duplicate authority and prematurely couple semantic contracts to import execution.

requirements: Dataset nodes are semantic metadata only; they never authorize access to source data, secrets, files, databases, APIs, or environments.
A provenance/source reference is not proof that data was read, imported, verified, or safe; execution evidence remains separate.
Production or sensitive data must never be copied into lower-trust environments merely because a Dataset node exists.

outcome: The Product Graph can represent Dataset, DatasetVersion, DataImport, and DataMapping as closed deterministic semantic nodes carrying explicit provenance, privacy/environment context, transformation/verification metadata, and no data-plane side effects.
rationale: IN-P02-S07-T01 is dependency-eligible because IN-P02-S02-T02 is canonically complete. Dataset semantics are broad, so this first Grain is deliberately bounded to the four core identity/provenance node contracts before profiling, quality, seed/synthetic, and relation semantics.

risk.recovery: Revert the four dataset-core node-kind/spec additions, their focused tests, exports, and evidence; all canonical Product Graph semantics through SG-000033 remain intact.

scope_in: Add closed Product Graph domain node kinds for Dataset, DatasetVersion, DataImport, and DataMapping using the existing deterministic domain validator machinery.

Define bounded required/optional scalar/list attributes so dataset identities expose provenance, privacy classification, environment, transformation lineage, verification requirements, source/import identity, and human-inspectable status where applicable.
Reuse existing Product Graph privacy/data-class vocabulary where semantically applicable instead of creating a competing sensitivity taxonomy.

Add focused positive and negative tests for required fields, unknown fields, field types, deterministic issue ordering, canonical graph validation compatibility, and preservation of all previously qualified node kinds.
scope_out: No file/spreadsheet/database/API reading, import execution, row transformation, schema inference, model call, source mutation, persistence write, Supabase operation, network access, secret access, or production-data handling.
No DataProfile, DataQualityRule, SeedDataset, SyntheticDataset, VectorCorpus, EvalDataset, or dataset relation/cross-node semantics; those remain later bounded S07 slices.
No ProductCompletenessManifest work, no P02-S06 semantic-reference relation repair, and no P03 context/model routing.
title: IN-P02-S07-T01A core Dataset semantic node contracts
